landing.subtitle: Transform fragmented khata notes, UPI slips, cash sales, and wholesale bills into an evidence-backed Financial Visibility Passport.
landing.problemTitle: Not a lack of trade. A lack of organized evidence.
landing.problemSubtitle: Millions of Indian micro-merchants generate robust cash flow daily, but personal bank accounts, paper registers, and unlinked QR slips make them invisible to institutional credit underwriting.
landing.problemSavingsDesc: Shop revenue, household groceries, school fees, and supplier transfers all jumbled in a single bank account.
landing.problemUpiDesc: Hundreds of daily ₹20–₹500 QR transactions that bank algorithms aggregate into flat, unverified monthly sums.
landing.problemCashDesc: Physical rupee notes exchanged at the shop leave zero digital footprint unless methodically logged in a daybook.
landing.problemKhataDesc: Meticulous paper records that credit officers cannot parse or verify without manual audit.
landing.problemInvoiceDesc: Distributor bills filed away in cardboard cartons, unlinked to bank debit lines.
landing.howItWorksTitle: From Scattered Fragments to a Living Passport
landing.dimensionsSubtitle: We never produce a single credit score. Instead, four transparent metrics show institutional reviewers how much of the business is evidenced.
landing.manifestoSubtitle: Honesty is our visual and functional feature.
landing.manifestoNotLoan: NOT a loan application or automated underwriting system. We never approve or deny loans.
landing.manifestoNotScore: NOT a credit scoring engine. We never collapse a merchant's livelihood into an arbitrary three-digit score.
landing.manifestoNotAuth: NEVER claims uploaded bills are third-party authenticated. All evidence is stamped transparently.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to make your micro-business financially visible?
landing.ctaSubtitle: 100% offline-ready. Client-side privacy. Built for Indian merchants.

evidence.title: The Evidence Centre (The Bridge of Evidence)
evidence.ribbonSubtitle: How well is your business documented and traced?
evidence.shelfDesc: Every uploaded statement appears as a physical document with the explicit 'SUPPLIED · NOT INDEPENDENTLY AUTHENTICATED' rubber stamp. Click any document to view its parsed contents.
evidence.obsDesc: Observations detect gaps, potential duplicates, and mixed transactions using neutral, encouraging language. Resolving them directly improves your Financial Record Completeness.
evidence.reconTitle: Owner-Declared UPI Sales vs Imported Bank Settlement Credits
evidence.reconDesc: Compares declared daybook UPI figures against actual bank settlement credits. Minor timing differences at month-ends are normal and explained neutrally.

passport.title: Financial Visibility Passport
passport.coverSubtitle: A transparent, tamper-evident document ready for voluntary bank inspection.
passport.limitationsIntro: This Financial Visibility Passport is governed by strict transparency covenants:
passport.limitation1: 1. Figures are owner-organised from supplied records and not independently audited.
passport.limitation2: 2. Uploaded documents are NOT third-party authenticated in this prototype.
passport.limitation3: 3. Recorded net cash movement is NOT equivalent to net commercial profit.
passport.limitation4: 4. No credit score, lending verdict, or underwriting recommendation is made.
passport.limitation5: 5. This report is supplementary information shared voluntarily by the business owner.
passport.fingerprintNotice: Calculated via Web Crypto API across all canonical transaction hashes.
